name: Color Theory
description: Color decisions that hold up to scrutiny: contrast ratios, token-based palettes, and systems that remap cleanly between light and dark.

name: Typography
description: Type scale, hierarchy, and pairing decisions backed by formulas and measurable readability — not gut feel.

name: Spacing & Layout
description: Space as a deliberate, systematic tool: padding vs. margin, whitespace as a UI component, and the token scale that keeps gaps consistent.

name: Figma Workflow
description: The mental models behind Figma's most misused features — Auto Layout, variables, and a clean handoff from design file to code.

name: Adobe XD Workflow
description: Rebuilding a design workflow around Adobe XD's shutdown — what actually needs remaking, and what safely carries over.

name: Mobile App Design
description: Designing for real devices: breakpoints as device categories, thumb zones, and where iOS and Android genuinely diverge.

name: Web Layout
description: Responsive layout as a contract, not a breakpoint list — CSS Grid, fluid sizing, and the traps no toolbar preview catches.

name: Design Systems
description: Design tokens and naming conventions that survive a rebrand instead of drifting back into hardcoded values.

name: Accessibility
description: Accessibility as a structural decision made in markup and states, not a final pass before shipping.

name: Prototyping & Motion
description: Motion timing backed by real physics — easing curves, duration, and when animation should exist at all.
